lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.command: Run the track delivery section in docs/runbooks/device-smoke-tests.md on an isolated device
steps: Open track settings before UID registration and verify upload is enabled and the control is available
Record and stop before UID registration; verify retained points have no track badge, then register without changing settings and verify automatic delivery
Disable upload and verify pending tracks do not contribute to badges or send points; re-enable and verify retained points are delivered
Confirm registration with a rejected packet; verify the badge survives transport failure and restart, hides after registered=false or changing hub and returns after the new hub confirms registration
Repeat after restart and a project switch, and reject a later packet to verify only accepted rows are acknowledged
value.expected: Enabled-before-registration intent survives registration, failed packets retain unsent rows and only enabled upload with confirmed registration of the current server/UID contributes to the pending track badge
